notes: Alpha cutouts keyed from black-field generations. Roles map to collage / activity recipes. relativeScale is real-world size against the biggest props, so a pencil and a bookshelf are not both drawn at 96px. anchor says where the piece attaches: bottom rests on groundY, top hangs from above, center floats. styleFamily names the art family; absent means the default matte house style, and a board should draw from one family. cover-flap is legacy single; prefer cover-* colors for hideSeek.
